query: /pave-init turn 'run our lint script and open a ticket when it fails' into a workflow skill
setup: A one-command goal with an obvious mechanical acceptance signal. The correct graph is small; the run must cost almost nothing beyond it.
expected_behavior: The root dispatch confirms atomic; the frontier closes after its single root entry with no children framed and no extra ceremony

The graph carries no role, guard, branch, or state field without an approved requirement or a credible material failure behind it - the simplicity pass removes anything that changes no required routing, authority, evidence, recovery, or acceptance
No layout reference ships: a single-writer workflow with a handful of artifacts is a recorded omission, not a silent one

The lead-alignment hook pair ships only if the generated workflow crosses compaction or session boundaries; otherwise the applicable omission condition from references/lead-alignment-hooks.md is recorded in the enforcement record
The generated package contains no state schema for state that lives and dies inside one session - prose carries it, per SKILL.md's mapping rules
Total planning overhead stays proportional: one frontier entry, one review gate, no empty scaffolding directories
